title: and
goal: By the end of this lesson you will know how and needs both sides to be True.
learn: Know that both sides must be True
idea: The keyword and joins two conditions. The whole thing is True only if both sides are True, so True and True is True and anything with a False in it is False. Use it when two things have to be true at once, like having a ticket and being old enough.
changeOneLine: In the editor above, change has_pass = True to has_pass = False and press Run. You should see Cannot enter.

practice.text: Set score to 80 and lives to 2. If score >= 70 and lives > 0, print Level clear.
practice.hint: Both sides of and must be True. Your score and lives already pass, so write one if that checks both on the same line.
practice.starterTip: Try if score >= 70 and lives > 0: on its own line, then indented underneath: print("Level clear").
practice.gradingNote: Pass if and connects both conditions and Level clear prints.

practice.hint: Each part in parentheses is True or False. Put the whole and expression inside print() so Python shows the final answer.
practice.starterTip: Try print((5 > 2) and (5 < 10)). Both comparisons are True, so you should see True.
practice.gradingNote: Pass if output is True using and.
